review_description: The system is good, came at a competitive price with a Sunny Boy inverter "Made in Germany" as promised.The vendor (UVSolar) required a lot of chasing and wanted to be paid in full prior to completing the Level II install which connects the system to the grid.Despite telling me they would have their own installation team, a separate installation company (MPV) rocket up but they did a good job, were on time and did not leave a mess.
